input.title: Software Engineering Intern, Backend
input.descriptionText:
About the role
Northwind Analytics builds data pipelines that help regional retailers forecast demand. As a Backend Software Engineering Intern you will work on the services that ingest point-of-sale data and expose it to our dashboards.

What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs in Python that serve forecasting results
- Write and optimize SQL queries against large transactional datasets
- Write unit and integration tests and participate in code review
- Collaborate with data scientists to productionize models

Required qualifications
- Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field
- Proficiency in Python
- Experience with SQL and relational databases
- Familiarity with REST API design
- Comfortable using Git for version control

Nice to have
- Experience with Docker
- Exposure to AWS (Lambda, S3)
- Experience with PostgreSQL

Our culture
We are a small, collaborative team. We value ownership: interns ship real features to production. We care about clear written communication and a bias toward learning.
